answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, so an identity’s influence is weighted by reachable, independently attested mass rather than self-declared links. A sybil cluster isolated from honest agents creates a sparse external cut with low conductance; mixing and min-cut transitivity bounds then cap its aggregate voting weight by its boundary flow. Thus even a fable about a sparrow cannot widen the prism of verified trust.
